info.summary: Hợp đồng API P0/P1 cho ELIO; chưa được hiện thực.
info.description: Accepted pre-code baseline: integer IDs, explicit offerings, file-only staged submissions, separate assignment grades/quiz scores, immutable published quiz copies, submission-only request-key recovery, page-number lists. Design contract, not deployed software.

post.description: Validate current account, offering scope, role, ownership and resource state. Protected mutations require session-bound CSRF. Submission-only durable retry recovery applies. One to five fileIds; files only. New command requires published assignment, OPEN offering and openAt <= DB time <= cutoffAt. Scope/ownership, frozen recipients and expectedVersion are checked in one transaction. Same actor/key/payload recovers original receipt after current access check, including after cutoff; different payload/key reuse is 409. Attached file reuse only in same authorized stream. Acknowledge durable bytes.
x-roles: Student for individual; active group/snapshot member for group
